name: track-changes-monorepo
description: Track-changes (suggesting mode) packages for ProseMirror/Tiptap: headless core, Vue 3 / React / vanilla JS adapters, screen+print CSS.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=track-changes-core && npm run build --workspace=track-changes-vue --workspace=track-changes-react --workspace=track-changes-vanilla
scripts.demo: npm run build --workspace=track-changes-core && npm run dev --workspace=track-changes-demo
